_comment: Firmament Ages shrine offerings (firmages-core SPEC section 2.6). Key: the Age whose ring holds the offering
(ring N = age_N, plinth N+1). item: the signature item laid on the plinth (enshrined as a relic). grants: the Age
the prayer unlocks, always the next one. Ages without an entry cannot be offered yet: their signature item is not
registered (Humming Core age_5, Data Matrix age_6, Star Chart age_7, Quantum Core age_8). Add them with the item.
Dawn has no entry: the shrine is built in the Stone Age, The First Spark quest grants age_0. Checked by
dev/validate_quests.py (item registered, item Age = key, grants = next Age, goal quest of the chapter).
